planets.name: TOI-2295 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-2295 with a 60.1-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-2295 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-2295. Its orbit and size follow Heidari et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
